definitions: An extra part or extension that is or can be joined to something to perform a particular function.
A feeling of love or strong connection to someone or something.
A computer file sent along with an email message.
The act of fastening or joining one thing to another.
examples: A vacuum cleaner with a brush attachment.
A deep emotional attachment to his childhood home.
Please see the file in the attachment.
The attachment of the trailer to the car.
